title: Acknowledged Unit Count and the Expedite Per-Unit Charge
content:
The units acknowledged decide how the per-unit rate is applied. For Factory Production Orders, the per-unit charge of an expedited build applies the per-unit rate according to the units on the signed order acknowledgment that covers the most units:

- when **more than 10** units are acknowledged, the first 10 are charged at the full rate and every unit beyond 10 at half the rate (50 percent of the rate);
- when **3 or fewer** are acknowledged, the per-unit charge is the class minimum expedite fee as one flat amount;
- otherwise every unit on the order is charged at the rate.

## Records read

The acknowledged units are those shown on the acknowledgment signed checkpoints of the order's milestone records; where more than one signed acknowledgment is on record, the one covering the most units is used. The units on the order are those on the factory order record.

## Bands on both sides

| Units on the acknowledgment covering the most units | Per-unit charge |
|---|---|
| 3 | the class minimum expedite fee, one flat amount |
| 4 | every unit on the order at the rate |
| 10 | every unit on the order at the rate |
| 11 | 10 units at the rate and 1 unit at half the rate |

## Hypothetical examples (rate of 45 dollars per unit)

- 14 units acknowledged: 10 units at 45.00 make 450.00, and 4 units at 22.50 make 90.00; the per-unit charge is 540.00.
- 2 units acknowledged on a Custom Size Build order (class minimum expedite fee 195.00): the per-unit charge is 195.00 as one flat amount.
- 8 units acknowledged on an 8-unit order: 8 units at 45.00, a per-unit charge of 360.00.
